html:
Figure. Figure 3: Single-Electron Buildup of Diffraction Pattern

Figure 3. Buildup of electron diffraction. "Blobs" indicate the locations of detected electrons. Shown are intermediate buildup patterns from the central five orders of the diffraction pattern (P_{12}) magnified from Figure 2, with:

  • (a) 2 electrons
  • (b) 7 electrons
  • (c) 209 electrons
  • (d) 1004 electrons
  • (e) 6235 electrons

The top panel (e) includes the Fraunhofer envelope overlay. In (a--c) the electron hits appear completely random; only after many electrons accumulate can the interference pattern be discerned. The final buildup took approximately 2 hours.

Panel (e) is the source for the digitized intensity profile used in the QOU double-slit simulator.
